items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eddie Gomez was in that band and a couple of others that became very good musicians.

ctx.x: Eddie Gomez was in that band and a couple of others that became very good musicians. That was pulling together the Newport Youth Band, that was after the European band and after Farmingdale High band, so that was one of the first.
So that was one of the first student bands.
